name: Apple Music Controls
summary: Apple Music player controls and AI tools
description: Favorite or unfavorite the playing Apple Music song, add songs to playlists, and see or reorder Playing Next in Ledge’s players. AI tools can inspect the current song, search the local music library, play a selected result, list playlists, add a selected song to a playlist, and create a playlist. Music actions use macOS Automation permission. Playing Next uses a private macOS interface and is experimental.
author: Ledge
